name: Porsche 911 RSR (2017)
description: The legendary mid-engine flat-six racer that combines Porsche's racing heritage with modern performance. The 911 RSR's rear-mounted engine provides exceptional mid-corner grip and rear-end stability, making it a precision instrument in the right hands. With 510 horses and a perfect weight distribution, it remains the championship's most dominant force—as Mario Dornellas's five victories demonstrate, this machine is built to win.

name: Porsche 911 GT3 R (992) '22
description: The cutting-edge evolution of Porsche's racing pedigree, the modern 911 GT3 R delivers contemporary performance wrapped in timeless sports car DNA. Its responsive steering and eager mid-corner rotation reward aggressive inputs, while the potent flat-six produces a distinctive howl through the rev range. In Stephen Corbin's hands, this machine proves that new technology can hold its own against racing legends.

name: Ferrari 296 GT3
description: The newest addition to Ferrari's GT3 arsenal, the 296 GT3 marries iconic Italian design with hybrid-assisted performance and pure racing passion. Its V6 turbo engine promises exhilarating throttle response, while the hybrid system provides intelligent power delivery and torque management. Luca Bruschi's piloting of this sophisticated machine signals Ferrari's future at the forefront of GT racing.

name: Ferrari 458 Italia GT3
description: An iconic masterpiece from Maranello, the 458 Italia GT3 delivers authentic Prancing Horse passion with its naturally aspirated V8 and responsive steering. Every lap is a visceral experience—the raw engine note and immediate throttle response make it one of sim racing's most rewarding cars for smooth, committed drivers. Charles Fernandez's dedication to mastering this thoroughbred reflects the machine's demanding, yet rewarding character.

name: BMW M4 GT Endurance Model
description: A powerhouse of Bavarian engineering, the BMW M4 GT Endurance delivers impressive straightline speed and stability with its turbocharged inline-six. Despite its weight, the M4's sophisticated balance and responsive steering make it deceptively agile through technical sections. Bibi Erikkson exploits the BMW's raw pace and torque advantage to consistently score championship points.

name: Lamborghini Huracán GT3
description: A wild, aggressive Italian supercar bred for competition, the Lamborghini Huracán GT3 delivers visceral performance and angular design that intimidates competitors on the grid. Its all-wheel-drive system and brute force provide confident traction, while the V10 engine roars with untamed aggression. Ross Bloomfield's Huracán represents unbridled automotive passion seeking expression on the racetrack.

name: Toyota GR Supra Racing Concept
description: A lightweight, agile machine that rewards smooth inputs and precision over raw power, the Toyota GR Supra Racing Concept is a masterclass in efficient racing design. Its responsive steering and balanced chassis excel at extracting maximum pace through technical sections with minimal aggression. Ali Fuller's methodical approach suits this car perfectly—it demands respect, concentration, and the kind of mechanical sympathy that separates good drivers from great ones.

name: Audi R8 LMS Evo '19
description: A technically sophisticated racing instrument from Ingolstadt, the Audi R8 LMS Evo combines all-wheel-drive traction with a perfectly balanced chassis and responsive steering. This machine rewards precision and forward planning, with its intelligent torque vectoring helping navigate complex corner sequences. In Luca Ascarelli's hands, the R8's balanced nature and consistent performance make it the second-most dominant force in the championship.

name: Nissan GT-R NISMO GT3
description: A legendary performance icon evolved into a formidable racing platform, the Nissan GT-R NISMO GT3 delivers confidence-inspiring all-wheel-drive traction and aggressive aerodynamics. Its heavy yet composed character and turbocharged acceleration provide a unique driving experience that rewards commitment and bravery. Kai Ross's growing mastery of the GT-R demonstrates how the Japanese machine's raw potential rewards aggressive, skilled pilots.

name: Lexus RC F GT3
description: A refined, elegant machine that brings Japanese luxury brand credibility to competitive racing, the Lexus RC F GT3 combines smooth power delivery with balanced handling and composure. Its naturally aspirated V8 produces a distinctive howl, while sophisticated chassis tuning helps exploit any advantage in mixed conditions. Alex Mansoor's tactical approach suits this machine's measured, intelligent performance philosophy perfectly.

name: Dodge Viper GTS-R GT3
description: A brute-force American muscle car reimagined as a cutting-edge racing machine, the Dodge Viper GTS-R GT3 delivers raw power and uncompromising character. Its massive naturally aspirated V10 produces over 600 horsepower and an unforgettable engine note, while the heavyweight chassis demands respect and commitment. Sean Shoul's journey with the Viper represents an underdog's challenge to tame a wild, unforgiving automotive beast.

name: Mazda RX-Vision GT3 Concept
description: A lightweight, innovative Japanese concept that carries the Mazda spirit of driving enjoyment into the racing realm, the RX-Vision GT3 relies on precision and efficiency rather than brute force. Its rotary engine heritage combined with modern engineering creates a unique, rewarding driving experience for those willing to learn its particular character. Jeff D's commitment to mastering this unconventional platform speaks volumes about his dedication to the sport.

name: Genesis X GR3
description: A stunning entry from Hyundai's luxury performance division, the Genesis X GR3 represents cutting-edge design and technology applied to racing competition. Its sleek, aerodynamic profile and sophisticated inline-six provide smooth, responsive power delivery. Neil Gonsalves's measured approach to the season with this premium machine reflects his understanding that familiarity and confidence build gradually but last longest.

name: Renault R.S.01 GT3
description: A technically sophisticated French racing machine, the Renault R.S.01 GT3 delivers responsive handling and eager mid-corner rotation wrapped in an angular, purposeful design. Its turbocharged power plant provides exciting acceleration, while the balanced chassis rewards smooth, committed inputs. Cameron Browne's recent improvement trajectory with this machine suggests he's finally unlocking its competitive potential and emerging as a genuine mid-field threat.
